svg.title: Keep the incident around the notification
svg.desc: Four cases group one notification, simultaneous notifications across assets, repeated observations of one asset, or their combination. Arrival time, property and asset identity, and labels determine grouping. Each frame still needs judgment. The selected notification and incident evidence travel together. For suspicious or crime-labelled incidents, the same operator and manager continue for that monitoring session.

g.aria-label: Judge each frame in its own right.
Carry context to the next handler
